title: Associated graded of a regular-sequence ideal is polynomial
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $c\in\mathbb N$, and let $f_1,\ldots,f_c$ be an $R$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Put $J=(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$, $B=R/J$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], and give
$$\operatorname{gr}_J(R)=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}J^n/J^{n+1}$$
the graded $B$-algebra structure of [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Give $B[T_1,\ldots,T_c]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] its total-degree grading. The $B$-algebra homomorphism
$$\theta:B[T_1,\ldots,T_c]\longrightarrow\operatorname{gr}_J(R),\qquad T_j\longmapsto[f_j]_1,$$
which is the identity on $B$ in degree zero, is an isomorphism of graded algebras. In degree $n$ its formula is
$$\theta\left(\sum_{|\alpha|=n}\bar a_\alpha T^\alpha\right)=\left[\sum_{|\alpha|=n}a_\alpha f_1^{\alpha_1}\cdots f_c^{\alpha_c}\right]_n.$$
In particular the degree-$n$ monomials in the $f_j$ form a $B$-basis of $J^n/J^{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$.
